notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) for robots.txt, homepage, sitemap.xml/sitemap_collections_1.xml, and all category pages - full mega-menu and page HTML rendered server-side and readable. robots.txt (Shopify default) is User-agent: * Allow: / with only private/transactional paths disallowed - no block on any tier. TREE: union of homepage mega-menu (header/nav links), the collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 319 URLs), and each category page's own 'clc-Banner_Collections' sub-nav strip (checked on Textiles, Storage Accessories, Cushions, Rugs, Bedroom/Dining Room/Living Room/Hallway/Study room pages). QTY: tier (b) Playwright (chromium headless) required - the collection pages use a client-side 'graphene-hc' widget; the pagination 'Showing X of Y items' total is empty in raw HTML and only populated after JS hydration (~5s). Read data-graphene-hc-el=pagination-total text plus h1 per page as evidence; h1 matched the requested node on every leaf (no bad-slug silent fallback observed). EXCLUDED (Textile): Fabric Swatches (/collections/fabric-samples) and Tailored by OKA Fabric Swatches (/collections/made-to-order-fabric-samples) - free upholstery sample chips for furniture orders, not a finished home-textile product. Tailored by OKA (/collections/made-to-order) - a made-to-order furniture (armchairs/sofas) hub, not textile itself. Color/material/pattern/size cushion and rug variant pages (e.g. Blue/Green/Red/Natural/Pink/Yellow Cushions, Square/Rectangular/Linen/Floral/Silk/Velvet/Patterned/Plain/Cotton/Wool Cushions, Blue/Cotton/Green/Wool/Pink/Orange/Red/Natural Rugs, Large Rugs) - these are attribute-filter subsets of the same product type (Cushions / Rugs and Runners), not distinct product-type subcategories; excluded consistently with how Furniture.xlsx omitted equivalent color/material variant collections for this same company. Wallpaper - a wall covering, not a fabric home-furnishing textile. Placemats and Coasters - primarily Tableware/Kitchen & Dining (mixed material), out of scope. New Soft Furnishings / Sale Textiles - promotional New/Sale landing pages. EXCLUDED (Storage): Storage Furniture (/collections/storage-furniture) and its children (Sideboards, Chests of Drawers, Storage Trunks and Chests, Bookcases and Cabinets, Drinks Trolleys and Cabinets, Wardrobes) and Storage Ottomans (/collections/ottomans) - the site's own nav places all of these under Furniture (matches existing Furniture.xlsx rows for OKA), so Furniture wins per storage.md Sec21/27. Waste Bins (/collections/waste-bins, breadcrumb Home>Homeware) - primary function is refuse disposal, not organizing/storing belongings; excluded per storage.md primary-function rule. Trays and Carriers, Bar Accessories and Furniture, Fire Screens, Vases and Plant Pots, Candles and Holders, Home Fragrance, Garden Accessories (mixed merchandising collection spanning cushions/candles/tableware, not a single product-type category) - decorative/kitchen/furniture, not storage. GROUPING: Textiles (site parent of Cushions/Rugs and Runners/Throws and Blankets, confirmed via its own clc-Banner_Collections strip) recorded as a pure grouping row since valid subcategories exist (rule 25); Cushions likewise grouped because Cushion Covers/Floor Cushions/Outdoor Cushions/Cushion Pads and Fillers/Cushion Sets are genuine distinct product-type children (confirmed via Cushions' own sub-nav + sitemap). Rugs and Runners recorded as a leaf with its own qty because its only sub-nav child (Large Rugs) is a size-filter of the same product, not a distinct type. Bed Valances, Table Linen, and Tailored by OKA Loose Covers are standalone leaves (reachable via Rooms/Beds menu, sitemap, and Tailored by OKA menu respectively - not nested under the Textiles group in the site's own hierarchy) but qualify as genuine home-textile products (bed valance, table linens, furniture/sofa loose covers). Storage Accessories grouped (single confirmed child Storage Baskets and Boxes) even though its own page total (38) exceeds the child's count (14), per rule 25/consistency with the established Furniture.xlsx convention of not recording a parent's own aggregate once a valid child subcategory exists.
